title: Projects
subtitle: A selection of work spanning AI, embedded systems, and industrial automation.

items.title: AI Process Automation POCs
items.description: Multiple successful proof-of-concept projects applying generative AI to enterprise process automation. Spanned custom-built RAG pipelines over enterprise data, multi-agent orchestration, graph-augmented retrieval, and MLflow-tracked experimentation.

items.title: Spring State Machine Workflow Engine
items.description: Enterprise project built on Spring Framework with extensive use of Spring State Machine to model complex, long-running business workflows with auditable state transitions. Quality enforced via JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Sonarqube.

items.title: Seismic & Structural Monitoring Platform
items.description: Firmware and analysis software for integrated seismic monitoring devices. Embedded C/C++ for data acquisition (ADC, GPS) and Python/ObsPy tooling — GUI and CLI — for client-facing seismic data analysis.

items.title: Smart Marine Solar Charger
items.description: Intelligent solar-panel battery charger designed for boats, with adaptive logic to maximize harvest and protect the battery under varied marine conditions.

items.title: GPS Base Station
items.description: Designed and built a GPS base station for high-accuracy positioning, integrating GNSS receivers with custom firmware and a serviceable enclosure.

items.title: ARM Touchscreen Device Software
items.description: Full application stack for the Soft FX Skin Analyzer — an ARM-based touchscreen device: Qt/QML UI, OpenCV/GStreamer image processing, and a custom Yocto Linux distribution tailored to the hardware.

items.title: Workplace Safety Management System
items.description: Contributed to a large Java/JavaScript web-based management system for workplace safety, integrated against SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle DB.

items.title: PLC & Robotic Cell Automation
items.description: Hardware configuration and software development for Siemens / Allen-Bradley PLCs and Fanuc industrial robots. On-site testing and commissioning of automation lines across several clients.

items.title: Anthropomorphic Manipulator Base Joint
items.description: Bachelor's thesis project: end-to-end design and implementation of the base joint for an anthropomorphic robotic manipulator, combining mechanical design with control logic.
